text: Ohhh, $n. Our favorite customer! You want something to drink, eh? Why not try some of this sludge? It's sooooo delicious! Ha!
Awww, you're a funny guy, there, matey. I know I owe you money, just give me a little more time. I'll pay you soon, I promise!

|Comrade Camillo|
Ahoy there, if it isn't $n.
Camillo, it's great to see you! When did you get back? I know this is sudden, but I have a favor...
I don't have any money, so don't waste your breath.
That was cold. Aren't we still friends?
Of course. I don't have any money, but I've got the next best thing, a sponsor.
Are you serious? And who might this sponsor be?
The Duchess Franco, in Lisbon. She hired me, and when I told her about you, she offered to become your sponsor.
Really? That would be just the thing to save me from my debts. And, finally, a chance for adventure!
Aye, won't it be exciting? Two wild and crazy guys, cruising the high seas.
It sounds great, but even if she does give us money, we won't get very far, with all my debts. How much is she offering?
I don't know the amount exactly, but she said that she would take care of your debts, too. A pretty nice lady, eh?
Aye, though it sounds too good to be true. She's being too nice to us. There's got to be a catch.
Well, mate, what's it gonna be? Will you stay or go?
Hmmm.. a chance for adventure, or debtor's prison... ha, that's easy - let's get out of here!
Good. I've got a ship, but I'm leaving you in charge as Captain.
Alright then. I think I'll call her the Falcon. How's that sound?
Not bad. Unfortunately, we don't even have enough money to buy extra provisions, so we'd better not make any detours.
Well, then we'd better head straight for Lisbon.
We should head southwest and swing up around the Iberian peninsula. Of course, it's easiest to use the Auto Sail command!
Falcon
Have ye run into Camillo?
No, not yet.
He's probably in the pub. Maybe the two of you can figure out a way to pay me back.
Ahoy there, $n. Ye know, I wouldn't mind seeing some of that money ye owe me.
I want to pay you back, really I do. But I just don't have anything now.
I know it's not yer fault, being burdened with the debts of yer father. But I need to get my money back from someone. That leaves only ye, my friend.
Aye, Aye, sir. Once I hear from Camillo, I'm sure that I'll be able to pay you back. Just give me a little more time.
I sent him a letter asking for help a while back, so I should be hearing something soon.
Are ye talking about the Camillo that went to work for Duke Franco in Lisbon as a merchant sailor? That mate's in town right now!
Really?!
Aye, $n. I saw him walking towards the pub.
Really? Hey, I just might be able to pay you back sooner than I thought!
Welcome. $n, is today the day you're going to pay back some of your debts?
Who said that? I didn't hear anyone say anything like that.
Oh, I see. You're a tricky scoundrel, but I will get my money back. All of it.
Uh oh. I'd better get out of here.
Welcome, $n. Have you come to make a donation to the church, or just to return some of the money you owe?
Umm... I just remembered an important engagement. Bye!
Poor $n, it looks like you're running in circles trying to get out of paying your debts.
Don't worry, sonny, I'll hide you. You can just rest here for a while.
$n, you dirty crook! You'd better give me my money, or else!
Uh oh. I think I hear my mother calling. Sorry, gotta go!

|Butler Marco|
How nice to see you again, Sir Camillo. Walk right this way. The Duchess is waiting for you.
You must be $n. I'm glad you were able to make it. I've heard a great deal about you from Camillo.
I expect he has informed you that I plan to assist you in your adventures.
He also said that you were going to take care of my debts.
And that all I would have to do is sail around, discover amazing things, and report back to you.
That's correct. And when you find a village, I would like you to disembark and search for rare items.
And if we don't find anything, we should befriend the villagers, and they might help us find something.
Come on, lady, every adventurer knows that. What do you think, I'm stupid?
My apologies.
I don't know, Camillo. We couldn't ask for a better offer. And that makes me think there's something she's not telling us.
$n! That's an insult to the Duchess! A thousand pardons, my lady.
Don't think anything of it, Camillo. $n, you're a very perceptive man.
Actually, I do have one more thing I require of you.
My husband, Leon, sent my only son, Joao, off on a long voyage the other day.
I'm sure there was a good reason for that, but I just can't stop worrying about my son.
Are you saying you want me to be your son's bodyguard?
Sorry, but I'm not about to waste my time baby-sitting some spoiled rich kid.
You've got the wrong idea. I just want to know whether he's alright or not...
So you just want me to spy on him a little bit and then let you know how he's doing?
If you please.
If that's all, then, we accept your offer.
Thank you! Here is the money I promised. And I will take care of your debts.
I will reward you for each report you give me, depending on the importance of the information.
I am also giving you this telescope and sextant. My husband Leon used them a long time ago when he sailed the high seas.
Thanks, these'll really help, as any seafarer knows.
If I look through the telescope near a shore, I'll be able to see if there are ports or villages nearby.
With the sextant, I'll be able to track my latitude and longitude.
Please, make sure my son is alright.
Don't worry about a thing, leave everything to me.
Well, since everything's settled, we'll be off to the docks. Ciao!
Hey $n, where do you think you're going? You haven't even met your sponsor yet.
Oops! Sorry about that. Where does our sponsor live anyway?
Why, the biggest house in town, mate!
Wow, $n, I can't believe you were so blunt with the Duchess. I broke out in a cold sweat just listening to you!
Sorry, royalty makes me nervous. By the way, whereabouts is this Joao character?
Don't ask me. How should I know?
Never mind. We don't really need to go and find him anyway. We'll just make up stories to tell the Duchess.
What are you crazy?! Don't you feel even the slightest bit of responsibility?
Don't worry, don't worry. Let's just get this adventure underway.
What do you have in mind?
Hmmm...Why don't we go check out the Nile River?
The Nile? Then we've got to go all the way to the deep Mediterranean and the port of Alexandria.
But, if that's where you want to go, Captain, then let's batten down the hatches, trim the jib and set sail for Alexandria!
$n, we had better hurry up and see the Duchess.
Ohhhhhh, Welcome $n! Such a wealthy man will want some of our best - bilge water! Ha ha ha!
You're just too funny. Just give me a little more time. I promise I'll pay you back.
$n, we had better be on our way to Lisbon. Our provisions are running low.
Well, well! If it's not $n. Are you here to pay your debts?
That's funny, I don't remember saying I was here to pay my debts.
Hmph, a wise guy. Just remember, I will get my money. I never forget a debt. Never!
Blast! I'd better get out of here.
Hello there, $n. Have you come to make a donation, or perhaps to return the money you owe us?
Ah! I just remembered an important engagement. Sorry, got to run.
Hello $n. Are you busy running away from all the people you owe money?
Don't worry, sonny, you're safe here. Just rest here quietly.
$n, you dirty crook! Give me my money!
Uh-oh.
Hey $n. We had better be on our way to Lisbon. Our provisions are running low.
Master $n, is it true that you hold other contracts besides that with the Duchess?
Aye, it's true.
Well then what do you plan to do about your deal with the Duchess? I'm afraid I need you to renew your contract with us.
Please don't ever do this again. If you do, we will lose all faith in you.
I never agreed to this kind of contract!
Ye're $n, the adventurer, right?
What's it to you?
Every adventurer knows about the gold medallion. Do ye?
The gold medallion? Sorry, never heard of it. What is it?
Ye mean ye don't know? Well ye must have heard of the golden city of El Dorado, then.
Never heard of that either.
Shiver me timbers! Why it's the city of legend, El Dorado, made entirely of gold! From the buildings to the toothpicks, everything gold!
Have ye really never heard tell of it?
Not a word, mate. But what about it? And what about that gold medallion?
Well, I happens to have a map which tells where the gold medallion is hidden. I picked it from the pocket of a greenhorn sailor.
I'll sell it to ye for 2000 gold pieces. What do ye say, mate?
Sounds like bunk to me.
Criminy! Don't say that. Why, I'd be out there searching meself if I weren't so old.
How about I sell it to ye for 1000 gold pieces then. That shouldn't lighten your purse too much.
If there were anything buried there, it'd be quite a haul.
Hmmm, well... here's the money then.
Thank you sirs. Since ye were so kind, let me tell ye where the map comes from.
That medallion was hidden, long ago, by pirates.
It is said that an adventurer from Portugal went forth in search of El Dorado to bring back some of the treasure.
The natives treated the adventurer well, so he gave them the medallion. But after that, he was never seen again.
Later on, pirates stole the medallion from the natives and hid it.
I heard this yarn meself from an old sailor, but I don't know how much is true. But, if it is...
I think you're lying to us, but I'll buy it off you anyway. Here, your 2000 gold pieces.
So the city of El Dorado is in the vicinity of this map too, right?
Eh? Oh, aye, aye, matey. I forgot to tell ye something. That medallion was hidden by pirates a long time ago.
It is said that an adventurer from Portugal went on a quest for El Dorado to bring back some of the treasure.
The natives had treated the adventurer well, so he gave them the medallion. But after that, he was never seen or heard from again.
Later on, pirates stole the medallion from the natives and hid it.
So the golden medallion is the only treasure marked on this map?
Aye. But if ye find it, 2000 gold pieces would be like a drop in the bucket. If ye find it.
Well, he was probably pulling our leg, but you never know. I have a feeling we'll find something.
Master $n, is it true that you hold other contracts besides that with the Duchess?
Aye, it's true.
Well then what do you plan to do about your deal with the Duchess? I'm afraid I need you to renew your contract with us.
Please don't ever do this again. If you do, we will lose all faith in you.
I don't remember agreeing to a contract like this!
Say $n, could I take a look at the gold medallion?
Here you go, pal. Check out the detail of the artwork - pretty amazing, eh?
There's a mountain of gold just like this medallion in El Dorado...
Come on $n, what do you say? Let's go search for El Dorado!
You bet, Camillo! I'm sure we'll find it. The search for the legendary city of gold. Now this is adventure!
Master $n, is it true that you hold other contracts besides that with the Duchess?
Aye, it's true.
Well then what do you plan to do about your deal with the Duchess? I'm afraid I need you to renew your contract with us.
Please don't ever do this again. We would lose all our faith in you.
What kind of restrictive contract is this!
Welcome, Master $n. The Duchess is entertaining a visitor right now.
I will go and see if she is ready to receive you. Please wait here.
I apologize for the wait. This way please.
Perfect timing, gentlemen! What a coincidence.
Let me introduce you. This is my son, Joao.
Joao, this is $n, an adventurer.
It's a pleasure to meet you, $n. Actually, I have a favor to ask of you.
A favor? Wow, imagine that, the Franco house asking me for a favor?
I'll be happy to listen, as long as you're not looking for money.
Do you know anything about Poseidon's Staff? According to legend, it's the secret treasure of Atlantis.
Sorry, never heard of it.
Well, I need you to find it for me. It's extremely important!
Whoa, sounds serious! Why is this staff so special? What do you need it for?
Atlantis was a land with very advanced technology.
But many, many years ago it sank into the sea in a terrible earthquake. Only a few survivors managed to escape.
The descendants of those survivors are now scattered around the globe, but a large group of them ended up settling in the port of Massawa.
The Atlanteans feared that their knowledge, their secret technology, would fall into the wrong hands. They decided to keep it hidden, and started to live normal lives.
But the Turkish Empire has learned of the Atlantean's technology and is preparing to wage war on them.
I don't know why, but they say that in order to defeat the Turks, they must unleash the power of Atlantis. To do that, they need Poseidon's Staff.
Hmmm, sounds intriguing. And how can I turn down a request from the great house of Franco? Sure, I'll go look for your Staff.
Thank you. I won't forget this. When you find it, do you think you could bring it to the port of Massawa?
Say $n, are you sure we should have taken on this job? He is the Duke's son, but...
We don't even know where to start.
Don't worry. Que sera, sera!
But those people are counting on you! Don't you feel any responsibility at all?
Don't worry! As long as we start out on our way to Arabia, something will come up.
Master $n, is it true that you hold other contracts besides that with the Duchess?
Well then what do you plan to do about your deal with the Duchess? I'm afraid I need you to renew your contract with us.
Please don't ever do this again. If you do, we will lose all faith in you.
Excuse me, but I was wondering if you've ever heard of Poseidon's Staff?
P..Poseidon's Staff?! Oh my goodness.
The staff gives the holder incredible power. It changes a man's spirit into power.
Evil men gain evil power, and good men gain good power. Long ago, men, fearing that the staff would fall into evil hands, hid the staff for safe-keeping.
As time passed, the warnings of the elders were abandoned, and the staff was brought forth once again. The results were devastating, and the staff was lost again.
That is the legend passed down over the ages. As you have heard, the staff was lost and remains so today. You're looking for this staff?
I was asked by someone to find it, for the people of Massawa. So they can restore the power of Atlantis.
The restoration of the power of Atlantis... There's more to the legend.
When the people of Atlantis fear the power, and are in great need of help, the staff will appear again.
Go to the pub in $r19.
If you tell them you heard about the staff from me, I'm sure they will tell you more.
Excuse me. Have you ever heard of the legend of Poseidon's Staff?
Ah, yes. There are many rumors about its fantastic history and special powers.
Where is it?
I have no idea. But the fortune teller in the port of $r19 may know.
Thanks. You've been a big help.
You said it yourself -  it's only a legend. It exists only in our minds.
Excuse me, but I was told by the fortune teller in the port of $r19 that someone here would tell me where I can find the staff.
...Oh, so you heard about it from my sister. The Atlanteans are in trouble, eh?
They need the staff to reunite their people and unlock their hidden power. I'm just looking for it as a favor to a friend.
A favor? For whom?
I'm doing it for Joao, a Portuguese noble who's trying to help the descendants of Atlantis, the people of Massawa.
Oh, I see. Well, if your friend is helping the people of Massawa, then I will trust you.
The legend that's been passed down in my family for generations is that our ancestor was saved by the Atlanteans after he was found drifting at sea.
The elders, knowing that only Atlanteans could use the staff and unlock its incredible power, had my ancestor hide it away.
Ever since that time, my family has been the protectors of the map that shows where the staff is hidden. But we must now bring it forth.
Please, I sincerely ask for your help. Take this map, find the staff, and lend the Atlanteans your strength.
Alright. As long as I have the map, it'll be easy to find. You can leave it to me!
This is the map which shows where the staff is buried.
Please..you must find it. I, my whole family, owe our lives to the Atlanteans.
Say, you're stowing quite a bit of luggage there. Why don't you come back after you've unloaded something.
Thanks.
We're supposed to ask at the pub in this port. Come on, let's go!
Do you think the fortune teller in this town really knows about Poseidon's Staff? Well, let's go and see.
There's bound to be somebody who knows about the legend of Poseidon's Staff in this port.
Why don't we go to the pub and ask around?
$n, let's get on our way to Arabia.
Master $n, is it true that you hold other contracts besides that with the Duchess?
Well then what do you plan to do about your deal with the Duchess? I'm afraid I need you to renew your contract with us.
Please don't ever do this again. If you do, we will lose all faith in you.
Joao, we've found the staff.
Really? I can't thank you enough. Ah, yes a reward. Is there anything you want? Just name it.
Hmmm. Have you ever heard of the Land of Gold, El Dorado?
No, I've never heard of it, but if I learn anything, I'll let you know.
Thank you.
Say, do you know where I could find a guy named Joao?
Master Joao is in the pub I think, but... who are you people?
Sorry, but we're in a hurry. Later, old man.
Say, do you happen to know a guy named Joao?
Joao is over in the pub.
Did you find Poseidon's Staff?
We sure did. Here it is.
So, this is Poseidon's Staff?... Please take it to Massawa, and hurry!
You haven't found it yet? Please hurry, it's very important.
Have you found Poseidon's Staff yet?
We sure did. Here.
So, this is Poseidon's Staff?... You must take it to Massawa, and hurry!
You haven't found it yet? Please hurry, it's very important that you find it.
Let's take the staff to Joao in Massawa. Hoist those sails!
Master $n, is it true that you hold other contracts besides that with the Duchess?
Aye, it's true.
Well then what do you plan to do about your deal with the Duchess? I'm afraid I need you to renew your contract with us.
Please don't ever do this again. If you do, we will lose all faith in you.
Where the blazes is the fine print to get us out of this contract?!
Are you $n, the adventurer?
Who are you?
I'm Ali Vezas, a merchant. I was sent by Joao to find you.
By Joao?
Right. I'm doing him a favor. Trading favors, trading goods, it's all business to me! So I have a message for you.
'It's not El Dorado, but around the coordinates 35@N 135@E, there is a country called Zipangu, the Golden Country.'
That's all. Gotta go!
What do you think, $n? Should we go to Zipangu?
Sounds pretty interesting. Let's go.
Master $n, is it true that you hold other contracts besides that with the Duchess?
Well then what do you plan to do about your deal with the Duchess? I'm afraid I need you to renew your contract with us.
Please don't ever do this again. We would lose all faith in you.
Say $n, this is Zipangu, but it sure doesn't look like the golden country of El Dorado.
Let's look around some more.
Say $n, this is Zipangu, but it's sure not the golden country of El Dorado.
Where in the world is El Dorado anyway?
Are you fellows looking for a place called El Dorado?
Who're you?
My name is Ernst. I've been traveling the globe in order to make an accurate world map.
Well then, do you know where El Dorado is?
No, I've never heard of it. I can't tell just by the name. (Sigh) I guess the sooner I finish this map the better.
Hmmm. Well, it's probably a place that not too many people have been to.
Then I think your best bet would be the South American Continent.
Try around the equator, somewhere between 50 and 70 degrees west.
Thanks. We might as well go and check it out.
Master $n, is it true that you hold other contracts besides that with the Duchess?
Well then what do you plan to do about your deal with the Duchess? I'm afraid I need you to renew your contract with us.
Please don't ever do this again. If you do, we will lose all faith in you.
Well, $n, I guess we're in South America now! But it's so big, I don't know how we're going to find El Dorado.
Sounds pretty tough, eh? Oh! Camillo, look! That guy looks hurt!
You're right! Come on, let's go help him.
He's still breathing. Hey, wake up!
Huh? Where am I? What happened to me?
This is the port of $r01. You must have washed up on shore, and then stumbled in here. Do you remember anything?
Thank you for helping me. I owe you a great debt.
What happened? By the way, I'm an adventurer, $n $s's the name.
$n, huh? I am.. was.. an adventurer myself, Raul Franco of Portugal.
Franco?! Any relationship to Duke Franco?
Duke?
Yes, The Duchess Franco is sponsoring my travels.
My ancestors were nobles, but in my generation we were just poor merchants. Aye, that was a long time ago!
I've been a prisoner for the past 10 or 15 years.
Prison? Would you mind telling us what happened? I'm sure we can help you.
It was over 20 years ago... my ship was destroyed in a storm. Somehow I made it ashore and found my way to a village.
For several years, I lived in that village, enjoying peaceful days, waiting for a ship to sail by and take me home.
But one day, an army invaded, so I ran deep, deep into the heart of the mainland.
Suddenly, before my eyes, a wondrous sight appeared. Aye, it was amazing...
Raul, what was it? What did you see?
The legendary city, in the Land of Gold, El Dorado.
What?! You mean you found El Dorado?!
Aye, that was El Dorado alright, so bright and beautiful...
You wouldn't believe how shiny and bright it was. Everything was made of gold. It hurt my eyes just to look at it!
I took several trinkets and left El Dorado.
I continued walking into the heart of the mainland, and eventually emerged on the other side, at another village.
I must have spent years there, waiting for a ship from Portugal to come by.
One day, I heard that some Portuguese were building a town nearby, so I went to have a look.
Raul, have you ever seen this medallion before?
What medallion? Th..this is the medallion that saved my life. I gave it to the villagers as thanks for their hospitality.
Hmmm, I thought it was just a yarn, but I found what the pirates that attacked your village had hidden.
I believed that El Dorado really exists, and came here to search for it.
This medallion has been around the world and yet again saves my life. Ach, the winds of fate are a strange thing, my lad.
But where was I? Oh yes, I went to go see the Portuguese town.
As soon as I reached the town, I was arrested and thrown into prison.
I found out later, it was the army that had attacked my village before.
They are Portuguese, but they have betrayed their king, in order to try for world domination.
I spent many long years in that prison. But several days ago, suddenly the camp was buzzing with activity.
I don't know what caused the commotion, but I saw my chance and escaped.
You were lucky to get away safely.
Don't I know it! Now, all I want is to go home to Lisbon. Every day in prison, all I thought about was Lisbon.
Ah, the beautiful port of Lisbon. My first mate Rocco.
Rocco?
And the son I left behind, Leon.
Wai..Wait a minute! Your son's name is Leon?!
Yes, Leon Franco.
Leon Franco... as I mentioned earlier there is a Duke Franco, and his name is Leon!
Is that true? Could it really be?
I'm certain I heard that Duke Leon used to be an adventurer.
He rescued the Princess of Portugal, who had been kidnapped by pirates. She fell in love and married him, and the King made him a Duke.
And the old sailor with the Duke's son, Joao, is called Rocco.
Duke Leon must be your son!
Then it's true. So my boy Leon has become a Duke...
Let's go. We're taking you to Lisbon.
But, you came all this way to search for El Dorado, right?
Don't worry about it. It's not going anywhere! And you remember the way, don't you?
I think I can still draw a map of the area.
That's good enough. You're the one who found El Dorado anyway. I don't want to take credit for someone else's discovery.
You're quite an adventurer. My respects.
Thank you, thank you very much.
OK then, let's get back to Lisbon. Duke Leon will sure be happy to see you!
It's going to be tough. But that's why it's called an adventure. Besides, it wouldn't be a legend if just anyone could find it.
Let's stop by a port and see if we can find anything out.
Say, have you ever heard of El Dorado?
Sure. That's the legendary city in the land of gold, right?
Where is it?
Where is it? If I knew that, I'd be a rich man now. Just a legend, my friend. Just a legend...
Hey $n, we'd better go straight to Duke Leon's.
Come on men! We've got to get Raul back to Lisbon!
